svg.title: Tech radar
svg.desc: Tech radar of the agentic AI stack in four quadrants. Agents & harness: LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, Agno, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Code, Event-driven agents, DSPy, Computer-use agents. Protocols & governance: MCP, A2A protocol, Agent skills, Human-in-the-loop, MCP registries, RBAC · tenancy, Prompt-injection defense, Tool sandboxing, Policy-as-code, Audit trails. Memory, retrieval & evals: Mem0, Graphiti, pgvector, GraphRAG, Context engineering, Opik · OpenTelemetry, LLM-as-judge, Trajectory evals, τ-bench, Terminal-Bench. Inference & routing: Model routing, AutoLLM selection, KServe, NVIDIA NIM, vLLM, SGLang, QLoRA · LoRA, Speculative decoding, GPU scheduling, Small on-device models.
svg.text: TECH RADAR · THE AGENTIC AI STACK
